# Xntric — Digital Marketing Agency Canada
# https://xntric.ca

> Xntric is an award-winning digital marketing agency based in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, offering 360-degree services including SEO, Social Media Marketing, Web Development, UI/UX Design, Mobile App Development, Branding, Video Production, Game Marketing, and AI Integration. We serve businesses across Canada including Toronto, Vancouver, Calgary, and the GTA with data-driven, performance-focused strategies.
